metadata.title: Markets brace for Fed decision and Big Tech earnings

content.text:
00:05 Speaker A
Time now for to watch Wednesday, July 29th.
00:07 Speaker A
The Federal Reserve set to announce its latest interest rate decision followed by earnings from two Magnificent Seven names.
00:13 Speaker A
Starting with the Fed, the Fed making its latest decision on interest rates in the afternoon.
00:17 Speaker A
It's the second FOMC meeting with Kevin Warsh as Fed chair.
00:20 Speaker A
Fed widely expect to hold rates steady, but focus will be on Warsh's comments after that decision.
00:24 Speaker A
Yahoo Finance will begin coverage on Wednesday just before 2:00 p.m. Eastern.
00:28 Speaker A
Then after the market's close, Microsoft reporting earnings.
00:30 Speaker A
Investors will keep a close eye on those results, but another big story is AI spending.
00:34 Speaker A
Analysts looking for more clarity on whether Microsoft plans to keep ramping up investment in data centers as well as updates on Azure growth.
00:41 Speaker A
Another Mag 7 name, Meta, also reporting after the close on Wednesday.
00:44 Speaker A
Wall Street watching for updates to, you guessed it, AI spending plans.
00:48 Speaker A
And it's looking for signs those investments are paying off through advertising and AI tools.
